query: What contingency analytic plans and minimum viable sample-size adjustments should we predefine if NPD access, linkage, or school recruitment is delayed or restricted?

response.query: What contingency analytic plans and minimum viable sample-size adjustments should we predefine if NPD access, linkage, or school recruitment is delayed or restricted?
response.answer: Predefine contingency plans for alternative data collection methods; adjust sample size based on expected participation rates; use statistical power analysis to determine minimum viable sample size.

results.title: Acute Care Nursing Staff Shortages That Compromise Patient-to ...
results.content: One study implemented a resilience initiative, which improved nurse wellbeing scores from 2.4 to 2.9 on a scale of 1 to 5, and decreased absenteeism by 39 percent.21 Use of an acuity tool when making nursing assignments was associated with higher staff satisfaction,23, 24 with one study identifying satisfaction increased from 73 percent to 95 percent.24 An acuity tool reduced assignment acuity by 11.3 percent.24 Participatory scheduling was associated with a greater sense of perceived control and a reduction in excessive sleepiness during evening shifts.22 Mandated ratios were associated with decreased nurse staffing turnover,25 increased satisfaction,25 increased nursing time of 58 minutes per patient day,34 and a reduction in injury by 31.6 percent for registered nurses and 33.6 percent for licenses practical nurses.32 Together, these studies indicate that different types of interventions can improve nurse wellbeing, but they do not explain how changes in nurse wellbeing affect specific patient-centered outcomes.
